hotels.title: Harbourside Yokohama Bliss with High-End Sushi Restaurant
hotels.description: Positioned on the cusp of the Yokohama Harbour, the nautical-inspired InterContinental Yokohama Pier 8, an IHG Hotel, is the harbourside hotel that dreams are made of. Meander across serene Japanese gardens, indulge in mouthwatering Edomae-style sushi at Sushi KATABAMI, swirl wine as you listen to live jazz at Restaurant & Bar LARBOARD and make use of the well-equipped fitness centre. During your stay, revel in the warmth of Japanese hospitality while watching the cruise ships enter the harbour.
